Python with comments, verify comment count

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `python`,
		Comments: true,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`# This is a comment
# Another comment
def hello():
    # inline comment
    pass
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Language)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Comments)
}
```
